_comment: The ground between regions. Read by scripts/content/bake-wildlands.mjs, which bakes it with
the region distance fields into client/shared/wildlands-field.js. Nothing reads this at runtime.
halo: how a region's own ground spreads into the wildlands around it. biome is a BIOME_GROUND
key, reach is how many tiles the blend runs before it is gone.
coast: the sea runs north of this row, taken from the named region's north edge plus offset,
and extended east and west across the whole map.
landforms: features that exist only in the wildlands. Render and prose only, never collision.
edge: how far past a region's rim its own edge terrain carries on before the wildlands take over, per terrain (tiles). Terrains not listed use default.
